conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is IRS Tax Refund Services. Am I speaking with Mr. Carter, owner of Carter Print Solutions?
Yes, this is him. How can I help you?
I'm contacting you regarding your federal tax filings. Our records show you're eligible for a $2,400 business refund related to recent stimulus adjustments. Congratulations!
Oh, I wasn't expecting that. Are you sure? I thought everything with my taxes was sorted.
Yes, according to IRS updates, you qualify for this refund as a small business owner. However, we need to verify your identity and process a clearance fee of $98 before we can release the refund.
A clearance fee? I don't remember anything like that in previous years. Is this normal?
Since 2022, IRS policy requires a refundable fee on certain business refunds to prevent fraudulent claims. It's a standard protocol, especially with increased tax fraud recently.
Alright, if that's what I need to do. How do I pay this fee?
For fastest processing, we recommend using a Zelle transfer to our secured IRS clearance account. I can provide you the payment details right now.
Okay, can you send me something in writing? I just want to make sure it's legitimate.

Unfortunately, we cannot send written notices for urgent tax matters due to privacy policies. If you do not complete the payment within the next hour, your refund will be flagged, and you may be audited for suspicious activity.
That sounds a bit scary. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing.
Mr. Carter, if you delay, your business account could be frozen, and you could face additional penalties. Many small business owners have lost their refunds by not acting quickly.
Alright, I suppose I don't want any trouble. So how do I send the payment?
Please open your banking app and go to the Zelle transfer section. The IRS clearance email is refund-clearance@irs-processing.com. Enter $98 as the amount and confirm once it's done.
Give me a moment, I need to get my phone. Are you sure this is safe?
Absolutely. We process thousands of these daily. If you have any issue, the fee is fully refundable once your refund is deposited.
Alright, I'm logging in to my bank.
Excellent. Please double-check the email address as mistakes can delay your refund for weeks.
Okay, I see the Zelle screen. It's asking me for a first and last name?
Enter 'IRS Processing' as the name. Remember: if the payment isn't completed by 3 PM, I'll have to report this, which will put your refund and potentially your business under review.
Alright, I'll send it now. Do I need to do anything else once it's done?
After you send the payment, confirm with me, and I will initiate the release of your $2,400 refund. If there are any issues, I can guide you through next steps to avoid further IRS action.
